text: Employees receive 20 days of paid leave per calendar year.
Employees must request leave from their manager at least 5 working days in advance.
Unused paid leave can be carried forward up to a maximum of 5 days.
Sick leave requires manager notification as soon as reasonably possible.
Employees can work from home up to 2 days per week with manager approval.
Employees must remain available during their team's agreed working hours.
Requests for extended remote work require approval from the department manager.
